description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Eos' (End of Stream) task in a media playback system, specifically testing the behavior of setting end-of-stream signals in a GStreamer-based media pipeline, including handling of stream presence and underflow conditions.

classes.name: EosTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the Eos task in various scenarios.

methods.name: shouldFailWhenStreamIsNotFound
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the specified media stream is not found in the context.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Tests successful setting of end-of-stream for an existing stream.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Tests failure to set end-of-stream when gstAppSrcEndOfStream returns an error.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndCancelAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for audio stream and cancelling audio underflow if occurred.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndSkipCancellingVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for audio stream and skipping video underflow cancellation if video underflow occurred.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndCancelVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for video stream and cancelling video underflow if occurred.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndSkipCancellingAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for video stream and skipping audio underflow cancellation if audio underflow occurred.
